episode_row: cross-game double graded on one game (+1 not +2); NameError in polling after the fix

commits.subject: fix: cross-game double-down streak counting
commits.body:
When double-down picks are in different games, the scheduler was only
polling the primary pick's game. When that game went Final first, it
would check the second pick's game which might still be in progress —
if check_hit returned None, the result list had only 1 element instead
of 2, so streak incremented by 1 instead of 2.

Two fixes:
1. scheduler: track all game PKs, wait for ALL games to be Final
   before recording results. If double check_hit returns None, mark
   as unresolved instead of silently dropping.
2. reconciliation: always recalculate streak from scratch, not just
   when result corrections are found. Catches streak increment bugs.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: fix: NameError in result polling after multi-game status change
commits.body:
The variable was renamed from status to statuses for multi-game
double-down tracking, but the suspended check still used the old name.
